tasks.label: Build BlendkitViewport (test project, UE 5.8)
tasks.detail: Compiles the BlendkitViewport C++ module against the test project (matches 'Launch test project' in launch.json). Close the editor first - fails with 'Unable to build while Live Coding is active' otherwise (use Ctrl+Alt+F11 inside the editor instead for a quick hot-reload).
